reviewItem.question: Does "Support for L7 protocol visibility using Pod annotations (`policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility`), deprecated since v1.15, has been removed" mean a change to config-key:cilium|path=metadata.annotations["policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility"]|component=Pod (removed)?

proposed.statement: Pod annotation policy.cilium.io/proxy-visibility, deprecated since v1.15, has been removed in Cilium 1.17.0.
